description: Graceful quit and relaunch: finish(shutdown) closes Figma at the last sample (4:59); a new engine reads the high-water mark from the store. The relaunched tracker's first samples are 2 s behind it (clock corrected during the reboot): clockBehind until 4:59, then a new interval with a new id starts exactly there.

steps.note: the new process' monotonic clock starts near 0
